journeys.name: Ordinary practice → saved review → progress, including interrupted save
journeys.observedSteps: Answer five questions → Submit → saved result. Separately, take a two-question quiz offline → failed-save state with answers retained → reconnect → Try saving again → saved confirmation. Open an answer explanation, filter a saved 3/5 result to two incorrect answers, and open an attempt from Reports.
journeys.scoreReason: Next/submit actions and storage feedback are explicit. Recovery preserves the completed work and gives a specific retry. Mobile result/history composition delays the learning detail, reducing information-load score.
journeys.notObserved: Successful Retry Incorrect execution, retrieval as history grows, multi-visit continuity and real learner comprehension were not observed. Repeated-use/growth and total withheld.
journeys.scope: Recorded isolated Chromium interactions on desktop and mobile; evaluator judgment; no real-user study.

journeys.name: Invitation and return cue / share fallback
journeys.observedSteps: Admin-capable fixture starts invitation → answers five → saved result → voluntarily keeps practice on dashboard → return cue appears. Separately, custom-quiz invitation copy succeeds, then a deliberately denied clipboard exposes a manual link. A learner with mismatched curriculum is redirected to the explanatory preview.
journeys.scoreReason: The scope and completion state are specific, with a meaningful voluntary return cue. Clipboard failure has an observed fallback. The long mobile quiz/summary sequence weakens proximity to the next action.
journeys.notObserved: Native Google sign-in, matched-curriculum learner handoff, actual sharing to another person, next-day return/expiry and reload continuity were not tested. Clipboard denial was synthetic.
journeys.scope: Recorded isolated Chromium interactions on desktop and mobile; evaluator judgment; no real-user study.

journeys.name: Paper retrieval and status inspection
journeys.observedSteps: Activate three register status tabs; search a deliberately unmatched phrase; load older records and assert more than 30 rows; open Updates, saved record activity, revision editor and teacher answer-key view.
journeys.scoreReason: The record/state vocabulary is specific and retrieval has observed filters plus older-record loading. The repeated mobile header and long appended rows slow comparison. These are bounded retrieval observations over 66 seeded conversations.
journeys.notObserved: Create/reply/retry/cancel submissions, actual asynchronous processing, clear-search action, persistence after interruption and native printing were not observed. Seeded error states establish appearance only.
journeys.scope: Recorded isolated Chromium interactions on desktop and mobile; evaluator judgment; no real-user study.

journeys.name: Manual generator to paper preview
journeys.observedSteps: Select format → choose ICSE/class9/Biology/Cells and a one-question section → Check availability → Preview paper; separately open Saved papers and wait for the loaded draft list.
journeys.scoreReason: Stages and coverage consequence are clear; repeated page navigation competes with current-step content on mobile.
journeys.notObserved: Save/open/resume draft, insufficient coverage, complex plans, print output and failed-save recovery were not exercised.
journeys.scope: Recorded isolated Chromium interactions on desktop and mobile; evaluator judgment; no real-user study.

journeys.name: Admin question/curriculum inspection and local editing
journeys.observedSteps: Expand question → select loaded review rows → open rejection confirmation without applying; open/close individual editor. Open/cancel library editing and archive confirmation; filter to no matches. Parse valid and invalid MCQ input. Open a syllabus subject and type an unsaved verification note; open an inline syllabus row editor.
journeys.scoreReason: Selection counts and flagged-approval restrictions are explicit. Navigation overhead, raw JSON editing, narrow confirmation controls and the large subject inventory weaken clarity and repeated inspection.
journeys.notObserved: No approval, rejection, archive, syllabus save or import save was executed. Query pagination beyond the first review batch, cross-session recovery and production volumes remain untested. The growth score reflects the observed 50-row review/273-subject fixture only.
journeys.scope: Recorded isolated Chromium interactions on desktop and mobile; evaluator judgment; no real-user study.

journeys.name: Plant Lab guided practice
journeys.observedSteps: Use Explore without saving → inspect anther and ovary → choose compatible pollen → inspect map/notebook → follow fertilisation → fruit/dispersal trial → compare propagation → five-question check → grading → local practice feedback completion.
journeys.scoreReason: Actions produce observations tied to the concept and a recorded discovery; the coherent stage supports guided attention. The mobile scene/controls need scroll-position validation and the summary could prioritize graded reasoning sooner.
journeys.notObserved: Saving attempts, saved-visit resume, failed-write recovery, normal-motion quality and long-term learning were not observed. Practice feedback stayed local.
journeys.scope: Recorded isolated Chromium interactions on desktop and mobile; evaluator judgment; no real-user study.

journeys.name: Current Lab guided practice
journeys.observedSteps: Make predictions → Try without saving → keyboard-adjust voltage and resistance, observing values and enabled Record observation → change series to parallel → record → five-question check → grading → Finish practice.
journeys.scoreReason: The manipulation, values and unlocked observation are causally linked. Mobile spatial separation and the long check/review form increase information load.
journeys.notObserved: Physical touch-drag, normal-motion timing, saved attempts/reload, recovery and retained learning were not observed.
journeys.scope: Recorded isolated Chromium interactions on desktop and mobile; evaluator judgment; no real-user study.

journeys.name: Profile curriculum save
journeys.observedSteps: Change Standard9 to10 → Save Changes → visible saved confirmation; restore Standard9 and save.
journeys.scoreReason: Save feedback is local and explicit, but the mobile edit fields are below a long metadata stack.
journeys.notObserved: Initial profile setup completion, failed save, reload verification and effects on later practice scope were not tested.
journeys.scope: Recorded isolated Chromium interactions on desktop and mobile; evaluator judgment; no real-user study.

journeys.name: Public entry demonstrations
journeys.observedSteps: Choose a sample answer → answered state appears. Toggle circuit → lamp-on state and explicit “Circuit closed. Lamp on.” text appear.
journeys.scoreReason: The page demonstrates learning rather than only promising it. Local visual/text feedback is clear; full mobile section painting is bounded by screenshot behavior.
journeys.notObserved: Sign-in, normal-motion scroll/pause behavior, repeated use, recovery and actual conversion were not observed. The capture requests reduced motion and disables screenshot animations.
journeys.scope: Recorded isolated Chromium interactions on desktop and mobile; evaluator judgment; no real-user study.

journeys.name: Active run answer and live-state inspection
journeys.observedSteps: Open seeded active run → submit first available answer → observe selected/locked state; a later mobile visit may already be locked because the account/session is shared. Opening an active live-player route redirects to its actual quiz surface. Host, lobby, missing and summary variants are rendered from fixtures.
journeys.scoreReason: Answer selection has visible feedback, but the seeded host question list fails mobile wrapping and the missing run resembles waiting. The scores cover this narrow observed interaction, not live orchestration.
journeys.notObserved: Create/join/start/end, synchronized multi-user transition, correct contest timing, reconnect, expiry and result calculation were not exercised. Long timer values are fixture choices.
journeys.scope: Recorded isolated Chromium interactions on desktop and mobile; evaluator judgment; no real-user study.
